Identity-aware records

People

Separate person records prevent similar names and initials from being merged without corroborating evidence.

Identity rule

A matching surname or initial is not enough. Occupation, hotel, location, birth information, residence, or chronology must corroborate an identity.

PERSON-SYLVESTER-HERMANN-GOTTLIEBWorking identity

Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb

Full name directly attested for a Baden-Baden hotelier in 1931, with a separate reported Vienna birth identity still under investigation.

Names used in research: Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb, Silvester Hermann Gottlieb, Hermann Gottlieb, S. H. Gottlieb, S.H. Gottlieb, Gottlieb, S. H.

Identity links
  • possible same person: S. H. Gottlieb — Open question
  • User suppliedCLAIM-BIRTH-VIENNA-1871

    Genealogical research identifies Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb as born in Vienna in 1871.

    Sources: SRC-011
  • Verified directCLAIM-SYLVESTER-BADEN-HOTELIER-1931

    A contemporary trade newspaper dated 20 March 1931 identifies Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb in Baden-Baden as a hotelier.

    Sources: SRC-020
  • Verified directCLAIM-MESSMER-LESSEE-1931

    The 20 March 1931 entry describes Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb as Pächter—lessee or operator—of Hotel Meßmer in Baden-Baden.

    Sources: SRC-020
  • Verified directCLAIM-GOTTLIEB-BANKRUPTCY-AUFHEBUNG-1931

    By 20 March 1931, a bankruptcy proceeding concerning hotelier Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb appeared in the Aufhebungen section for the Baden-Baden court district.

    Sources: SRC-020
  • Open questionCLAIM-IDENTITY-SYLVESTER-AND-SH

    Matching initials, profession, and chronology strongly support identifying the Zürich hotelier S. H. Gottlieb with Baden-Baden hotelier Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb, but no direct linking record has yet made the identification conclusive.

    Sources: SRC-001, SRC-002, SRC-003, SRC-004, SRC-008, SRC-009, SRC-011, SRC-020
  • Open questionCLAIM-DEATH-UNRESOLVED

    The date and place of death of Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb remain unknown in the dossier.

    No supporting source yet — open question
Source mentions: SRC-011, SRC-020

Caution: The Baden-Baden hotel career is directly attested under the full name in 1931. The Vienna birth remains user-supplied, and the Zürich initials record is strongly compatible but not conclusively linked.
